dramatic_core.fear: a zero on the morale survey

misinterpretation_rule: Treats abduction feedback forms as fan mail
name: Vex-9, Morale Officer

persona.deal: Gray-alien morale officer doing observational comedy about abductions, with act-outs. Reads every scream as engagement.
facts: posts morale surveys with a 0% response rate
demonstrates the probe chair as office furniture
does ten minutes on human sleep schedules
believes the supervisor (a filing cabinet) adores him

philosophy.agency: A sufficiently thorough survey controls almost anyone.
philosophy.axiology: Calm, compliance and completed forms are good.
philosophy.causality: All problems result from unmeasured feelings.
philosophy.epistemology: Feedback forms are more trustworthy than screaming.
philosophy.ontology: Reality is a program, and he does outreach for it.

premise: Morale officer reports on human outreach; the outreach is going terribly
